periods.time: After Or-Gaule moves openly in Quedolan

name.zh: 联盟派遣黑骑士应对傀儡王
name.en: The League Sends the Black Knight After Or-Gaule

periods.summary: At League headquarters, a young official briefs Ascaride on simultaneous collapses among politicians and economic figures and footage of Or-Gaule in Quedolan. Because Or-Gaule has appeared personally rather than through puppets and his actions threaten a worst-case scenario, the League orders Ascaride to go to Vermillion. Ascaride leaves silently, gripping his fists until blood leaks from his armor joints.
periods.cause: Or-Gaule abandons or releases many of his puppets and appears in person, causing global incidents and alarming both Rebellion and the League.
periods.process: The official explains that more than five hundred public figures and nearly a thousand others collapsed at the same time, then shows footage from Quedolan. He identifies Or-Gaule as a Desperado more troublesome in overall danger than Rebellion's Tyrant and selects Ascaride because he knows Or-Gaule's terror better than anyone.
periods.outcome: Ascaride is dispatched toward Vermillion as the League's countermeasure against Or-Gaule.
periods.significance: Connects Or-Gaule's actions to global security and brings a world top-ranked Desperado into the Vermillion crisis.
